voltage_note: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase available on request.
steel_note: Capacities are the manufacturer's ratings for one or more bars at once in steel of 45, 65 and 85 kg/mm² tensile strength (≈ 64,000, 92,500 and 120,900 psi). For Canadian Grade 400W rebar (minimum tensile strength 540 MPa ≈ 55 kg/mm²) use the 65 kg/mm² column as a conservative guide. Bar-size equivalents (Canadian metric bars and US bar numbers) are given for the single-bar capacity.

agents.title: Sales agents wanted across Canada
agents.kicker: Represent NovoTech in your city or province
agents.text: NovoTech is appointing independent sales agents and dealers in cities and provinces across Canada — British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario outside the GTA, Quebec and Atlantic Canada. If you already call on steel fabricators, rebar shops, precast plants, HVAC shops or contractors, add a proven line of GMS, Dener and other metalworking machinery to what you offer.
